integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a single continuous medium-wide shot in warm late-afternoon daylight frames a young woman in a light sweater, jeans, sneakers, and a shoulder bag walking briskly along the edge of a wide green campus lawn. The camera tracks laterally with small amplitude at slow speed, keeping her centered as she crosses the lawn edge from one side of the frame to the other. Her stride is energetic and light; she smiles softly, glances up at the sky, and brushes her hair back as a light breeze moves the grass and her hair. In the soft-focus background, students lounge on the grass, a frisbee arcs in the distance, and tree-lined paths lead toward a hint of campus buildings. Sunlight filters through the leaves, casting dappled light on the path, with warm, slightly saturated colors and shallow depth of field on the woman.

overall_soundscape: A light breeze rustles the grass and leaves while distant student chatter and laughter drift across the lawn. Footsteps move briskly along the path, a frisbee whooshes faintly overhead, and birds call softly in the trees.

non_diegetic_music: A warm acoustic-guitar pattern at a moderate tempo, joined by light percussion and soft piano accents, gently fading out at the end.
